import io = "./graph_io.qui"

class Promotion(int round, int vertex, int diff)
class Layering(int[] heights, int[] labels, int before, int rounds, Promotion[] promotions)

int[] sequence(int count, const io.Edge[] edges)
    remaining := array(nat(count), fill = true)
    int[] head := []
    int[] tail := []
    for: iteration < count
        outgoing := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
        incoming := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
        for edge := edges[]
            if remaining[edge.first] and remaining[edge.second]
                outgoing[edge.first] += 1
                incoming[edge.second] += 1
        sink := -1
        source := -1
        greedy := -1
        for: vertex < count
            if not remaining[vertex]
                continue
            if sink < 0 and outgoing[vertex] == 0
                sink = vertex
            if source < 0 and incoming[vertex] == 0
                source = vertex
            if greedy < 0 or outgoing[vertex] - incoming[vertex] > outgoing[greedy] - incoming[greedy]
                greedy = vertex
        chosen := if sink >= 0 then sink elif source >= 0 then source else greedy
        if sink >= 0
            tail = [chosen].concat(tail)
        else
            head = head.append(chosen)
        remaining[chosen] = false
    return head.concat(tail)

int height(int vertex, const int[][] lower, int[] &heights)
    if heights[vertex] >= 0
        return heights[vertex]
    result := 0
    for successor := lower[vertex][]
        result = io.maximum(result, height(successor, lower, &heights) + 1)
    heights[vertex] = result
    return result

int promote(int vertex, const int[][] upper, const int[][] lower, int[] &heights)
    diff := 0
    for predecessor := upper[vertex][]
        if heights[predecessor] == heights[vertex] + 1
            diff += promote(predecessor, upper, lower, &heights)
    heights[vertex] += 1
    return diff + int(#lower[vertex]) - int(#upper[vertex])

Layering assign(int count, const io.Edge[] edges, bool coffman, int width, bool promotion)
    int[][] upper := array(nat(count), fill = [])
    int[][] lower := array(nat(count), fill = [])
    for edge := edges[]
        upper[edge.second] = upper[edge.second].append(edge.first)
        lower[edge.first] = lower[edge.first].append(edge.second)
    for: vertex < count
        upper[vertex] = upper[vertex].sorted()
        lower[vertex] = lower[vertex].sorted()
    labels := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    heights := array(nat(count), fill = -1)
    if coffman
        for: 1 <= label < count + 1
            chosen := -1
            int[] chosen_key := []
            for: vertex < count
                if labels[vertex] != 0
                    continue
                eligible := true
                int[] key := []
                for predecessor := upper[vertex][]
                    if labels[predecessor] == 0
                        eligible = false
                    key = key.append(labels[predecessor])
                key = key.sorted()[::-1]
                if eligible and (chosen < 0 or io.compare(key, chosen_key) < 0)
                    chosen = vertex
                    chosen_key = key
            labels[chosen] = label
        current := 0
        placed := 0
        for: iteration < count
            chosen := -1
            for: vertex < count
                eligible := heights[vertex] < 0
                for successor := lower[vertex][]
                    if heights[successor] < 0
                        eligible = false
                if eligible and (chosen < 0 or labels[vertex] > labels[chosen])
                    chosen = vertex
            raise_layer := placed == width
            for successor := lower[chosen][]
                if heights[successor] == current
                    raise_layer = true
            if raise_layer
                current += 1
                placed = 0
            heights[chosen] = current
            placed += 1
    else
        for: vertex < count
            computed := height(vertex, lower, &heights)
    before := 0
    for edge := edges[]
        before += heights[edge.first] - heights[edge.second] - 1
    rounds := 0
    Promotion[] promotions := []
    if promotion
        while true
            rounds += 1
            changed := false
            for: vertex < count
                if #upper[vertex] == 0
                    continue
                saved := heights
                diff := promote(vertex, upper, lower, &heights)
                if diff < 0
                    promotions = promotions.append(Promotion(rounds, vertex, diff))
                    changed = true
                else
                    heights = saved
            if not changed
                break
    return Layering(heights, labels, before, rounds, promotions)

class Cell(int row, int column)
class Canvas(int main_length, int secondary_length, string direction)
    bool vertical := direction == "TB" or direction == "BT"
    int rows := if vertical then main_length else secondary_length
    int columns := if vertical then secondary_length else main_length
    bool[][] bars := array(nat(rows), fill = array(nat(columns), fill = false))
    dashes := bars
    corners := bars
    highlighted := bars
    string[][] arrows := array(nat(rows), fill = array(nat(columns), fill = ""))
    boxes := arrows

Cell map_cell(const Canvas picture, int main_coordinate, int secondary_coordinate)
    mapped := if picture.direction == "BT" or picture.direction == "RL" then picture.main_length - 1 - main_coordinate else main_coordinate
    return if picture.vertical then Cell(mapped, secondary_coordinate) else Cell(secondary_coordinate, mapped)

void line(Canvas &picture, int main_coordinate, int secondary_coordinate, bool in_main_direction)
    cell := map_cell(picture, main_coordinate, secondary_coordinate)
    if in_main_direction == picture.vertical
        picture.bars[cell.row][cell.column] = true
    else
        picture.dashes[cell.row][cell.column] = true

void corner(Canvas &picture, int main_coordinate, int secondary_coordinate)
    cell := map_cell(picture, main_coordinate, secondary_coordinate)
    picture.corners[cell.row][cell.column] = true

void arrow(Canvas &picture, int main_coordinate, int secondary_coordinate, bool reversed)
    cell := map_cell(picture, main_coordinate, secondary_coordinate)
    character := "<"
    if (picture.direction == "TB" and not reversed) or (picture.direction == "BT" and reversed)
        character = "v"
    elif (picture.direction == "TB" and reversed) or (picture.direction == "BT" and not reversed)
        character = "^"
    elif (picture.direction == "LR" and not reversed) or (picture.direction == "RL" and reversed)
        character = ">"
    picture.arrows[cell.row][cell.column] = character

void highlight(Canvas &picture, int row, int column)
    picture.highlighted[row][column] = true

void label(Canvas &picture, int row, int column, string text)
    for: position < int(#text)
        picture.boxes[row][column + position] = text[position]

int crossings(const Canvas picture)
    result := 0
    for: row < picture.rows
        for: column < picture.columns
            if picture.bars[row][column] and picture.dashes[row][column]
                result += 1
    return result

string trim_end(string text)
    finish := int(#text)
    while finish > 0 and text[finish - 1] == " "
        finish -= 1
    return text[0:<finish]

string[] report(const Canvas picture)
    ruler := "    "
    for: column < picture.columns
        ruler += string(column % 10)
    result := [ruler]
    for: row < picture.rows
        digits := string(row)
        text := ""
        for: padding < 3 - int(#digits)
            text += " "
        text += digits + " "
        for: column < picture.columns
            character := " "
            if picture.boxes[row][column] != ""
                character = picture.boxes[row][column]
            elif picture.arrows[row][column] != ""
                character = picture.arrows[row][column]
            elif picture.highlighted[row][column]
                character = "#"
            elif picture.corners[row][column] or (picture.bars[row][column] and picture.dashes[row][column])
                character = "+"
            elif picture.bars[row][column]
                character = "|"
            elif picture.dashes[row][column]
                character = "-"
            text += character
        result = result.append(trim_end(text))
    return result

import io = "./graph_io.qui"
import crossing = "./crossing.qui"

class Pair(int first, int second)
class Coordinates(int[] x, int[][] aligned, int[] blocks, int[] widths, int smallest, int conflicts, int[] left, int[] right)

Pair pair(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then Pair(first, second) else Pair(second, first)

int floor_half(int value)
    return if value < 0 and value % 2 != 0 then value / 2 - 1 else value / 2

int separation(int first, int second, const int[] left, const int[] right, int nodes, int node_sep, int dummy_sep)
    return right[first] + left[second] + 1 + (if first < nodes and second < nodes then node_sep else dummy_sep)

Coordinates assign(int nodes, const int[][] order, const int[] layer, const int[][] upper, const int[][] lower, const int[] width, bool vertical, int node_sep, int dummy_sep)
    vertices := int(#layer)
    places := crossing.positions(order, vertices)
    left := array(nat(vertices), fill = 0)
    right := array(nat(vertices), fill = 0)
    for: vertex < vertices
        if vertical
            left[vertex] = (width[vertex] - 1) / 2
            right[vertex] = width[vertex] - 1 - left[vertex]
    Pair[] marked := []
    for: gap < int(#order) - 1
        first_row := order[gap]
        second_row := order[gap + 1]
        boundary := 0
        start := 0
        for: position < int(#second_row)
            vertex := second_row[position]
            inner := vertex >= nodes and upper[vertex][0] >= nodes
            if inner or position + 1 == int(#second_row)
                finish := if inner then places[upper[vertex][0]] else int(#first_row) - 1
                for: start <= cursor < position + 1
                    lower_vertex := second_row[cursor]
                    for upper_vertex := upper[lower_vertex][]
                        if places[upper_vertex] < boundary or places[upper_vertex] > finish
                            entry := pair(upper_vertex, lower_vertex)
                            if not io.has(marked, entry)
                                marked = marked.append(entry)
                start = position + 1
                boundary = finish
    int[][] layouts := []
    int[] blocks := []
    int[] widths := []
    int[] lows := []
    int[] highs := []
    for: variant < 4
        down := variant >= 2
        right_scan := variant % 2 == 1
        rank := places
        if right_scan
            for: vertex < vertices
                rank[vertex] = int(#order[layer[vertex]]) - 1 - places[vertex]
        int[] root := []
        for: vertex < vertices
            root = root.append(vertex)
        align := root
        int[] layer_order := []
        for: row < int(#order)
            layer_order = layer_order.append(row)
        if down
            layer_order = layer_order[::-1]
        for: 1 <= row_index < int(#layer_order)
            row_number := layer_order[row_index]
            scan_order := order[row_number]
            if right_scan
                scan_order = scan_order[::-1]
            previous_rank := -1
            for vertex := scan_order[]
                reference := if down then lower[vertex] else upper[vertex]
                for: position < int(#reference)
                    cursor := position
                    while cursor > 0 and rank[reference[cursor]] < rank[reference[cursor - 1]]
                        saved := reference[cursor]
                        reference[cursor] = reference[cursor - 1]
                        reference[cursor - 1] = saved
                        cursor -= 1
                if #reference == 0
                    continue
                medians := [(int(#reference) - 1) / 2, int(#reference) / 2]
                for median := medians[]
                    neighbor := reference[median]
                    if align[vertex] == vertex and not io.has(marked, pair(neighbor, vertex)) and previous_rank < rank[neighbor]
                        align[neighbor] = vertex
                        root[vertex] = root[neighbor]
                        align[vertex] = root[vertex]
                        previous_rank = rank[neighbor]
        roots := io.unique(root).sorted()
        blocks = blocks.append(int(#roots))
        int[][] constraints := array(nat(vertices), fill = array(nat(vertices), fill = -1))
        for row := order[]
            scan_order := if right_scan then row[::-1] else row
            for: 1 <= position < int(#scan_order)
                first := scan_order[position - 1]
                second := scan_order[position]
                delta := if right_scan then separation(second, first, left, right, nodes, node_sep, dummy_sep) else separation(first, second, left, right, nodes, node_sep, dummy_sep)
                constraints[root[first]][root[second]] = io.maximum(constraints[root[first]][root[second]], delta)
        degree := array(nat(vertices), fill = 0)
        for first := roots[]
            for second := roots[]
                if constraints[first][second] >= 0
                    degree[second] += 1
        int[] topology := []
        processed := array(nat(vertices), fill = false)
        while #topology < #roots
            chosen := -1
            for vertex := roots[]
                if not processed[vertex] and degree[vertex] == 0
                    chosen = vertex
                    break
            processed[chosen] = true
            topology = topology.append(chosen)
            for successor := roots[]
                if constraints[chosen][successor] >= 0
                    degree[successor] -= 1
        first_y := array(nat(vertices), fill = 0)
        for vertex := topology[]
            for predecessor := roots[]
                delta := constraints[predecessor][vertex]
                if delta >= 0
                    first_y[vertex] = io.maximum(first_y[vertex], first_y[predecessor] + delta)
        second_y := first_y
        backwards := topology[::-1]
        for vertex := backwards[]
            int | none smallest := none
            for successor := roots[]
                delta := constraints[vertex][successor]
                if delta < 0
                    continue
                candidate := second_y[successor] - delta
                match smallest
                    int old
                        candidate = io.minimum(old, candidate)
                    none
                        void
                smallest = candidate
            match smallest
                int found
                    second_y[vertex] = io.maximum(first_y[vertex], found)
                none
                    second_y[vertex] = first_y[vertex]
        int[] layout := []
        lo := 0
        hi := 0
        for: vertex < vertices
            value := if right_scan then -second_y[root[vertex]] else second_y[root[vertex]]
            layout = layout.append(value)
            lo = if vertex == 0 then value - left[vertex] else io.minimum(lo, value - left[vertex])
            hi = if vertex == 0 then value + right[vertex] else io.maximum(hi, value + right[vertex])
        layouts = layouts.append(layout)
        lows = lows.append(lo)
        highs = highs.append(hi)
        widths = widths.append(hi - lo + 1)
    smallest := 0
    for: 1 <= variant < 4
        if widths[variant] < widths[smallest]
            smallest = variant
    for: variant < 4
        delta := if variant % 2 == 0 then lows[smallest] - lows[variant] else highs[smallest] - highs[variant]
        for: vertex < vertices
            layouts[variant][vertex] += delta
    int[] x := []
    low := 0
    for: vertex < vertices
        values := [layouts[0][vertex], layouts[1][vertex], layouts[2][vertex], layouts[3][vertex]]
        values = values.sorted()
        value := floor_half(values[1] + values[2])
        x = x.append(value)
        low = if vertex == 0 then value - left[vertex] else io.minimum(low, value - left[vertex])
    for: vertex < vertices
        x[vertex] -= low
    return Coordinates(x, layouts, blocks, widths, smallest, int(#marked), left, right)

import io = "./graph_io.qui"

class Segment(int upper, int lower, int edge)
class Pair(int first, int second)

int[] positions(const int[][] order, int count)
    result := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for row := order[]
        for: position < int(#row)
            result[row[position]] = position
    return result

int count(const Segment[] segments, const int[] places, int width)
    Pair[] pairs := []
    for segment := segments[]
        pairs = pairs.append(Pair(places[segment.upper], places[segment.lower]))
    for: position < int(#pairs)
        cursor := position
        while cursor > 0
            left := pairs[cursor]
            right := pairs[cursor - 1]
            if left.first > right.first or (left.first == right.first and left.second >= right.second)
                break
            pairs[cursor] = right
            pairs[cursor - 1] = left
            cursor -= 1
    capacity := 1
    while capacity < width
        capacity *= 2
    tree := array(nat(capacity * 2 - 1), fill = 0)
    result := 0
    for entry := pairs[]
        position := entry.second + capacity - 1
        tree[position] += 1
        while position > 0
            if position % 2 == 1
                result += tree[position + 1]
            position = (position - 1) / 2
            tree[position] += 1
    return result

bool crosses(const Segment first, const Segment second, const int[] places)
    return (places[first.upper] < places[second.upper] and places[first.lower] > places[second.lower]) or (places[first.upper] > places[second.upper] and places[first.lower] < places[second.lower])

int brute(const Segment[] segments, const int[] places)
    result := 0
    for: first < int(#segments)
        for: first + 1 <= second < int(#segments)
            if crosses(segments[first], segments[second], places)
                result += 1
    return result

int total(const Segment[][] gaps, const int[][] order, int vertices)
    places := positions(order, vertices)
    result := 0
    for: gap < int(#gaps)
        result += count(gaps[gap], places, int(#order[gap + 1]))
    return result

int adjacent(int first, int second, const int[][] upper, const int[][] lower, const int[] places)
    result := 0
    for left := upper[first][]
        for right := upper[second][]
            if places[left] > places[right]
                result += 1
    for left := lower[first][]
        for right := lower[second][]
            if places[left] > places[right]
                result += 1
    return result

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

int[] unique(const int[] items)
    int[] result := []
    for item := items[]
        if not has(result, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

int compare(const int[] first, const int[] second)
    count := if #first < #second then int(#first) else int(#second)
    for: position < count
        if first[position] != second[position]
            return if first[position] < second[position] then -1 else 1
    return if #first < #second then -1 elif #first > #second then 1 else 0

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

string[] setting_names()
    return ["layering", "width", "promotion", "heuristic", "sweeps", "node_sep", "dummy_sep", "layer_gap", "direction", "sifting", "reduce", "restarts", "seed"]

class Settings(values := ["longest", "4", "off", "barycenter", "12", "2", "1", "3", "TB", "off", "off", "0", "1"])
    string text(string key)
        names := setting_names()
        for: position < int(#names)
            if names[position] == key
                return values[position]
        return ""

    int integer(string key)
        result := int(text(key))
        return result

    bool on(string key)
        return text(key) == "on"

bool change_setting(Settings &settings, string key, string value)
    names := setting_names()
    index := -1
    for: position < int(#names)
        if names[position] == key
            index = position
    if index < 0
        return false
    string[] choices := []
    if key == "layering"
        choices = ["longest", "coffman"]
    elif key == "promotion" or key == "sifting" or key == "reduce"
        choices = ["on", "off"]
    elif key == "heuristic"
        choices = ["barycenter", "median"]
    elif key == "direction"
        choices = ["TB", "BT", "LR", "RL"]
    if #choices > 0
        if not has(choices, value)
            return false
        settings.values[index] = value
        return true
    if #value < 1 or #value > 10
        return false
    for: position < int(#value)
        if value[position].codepoints()[0] < 48 or value[position].codepoints()[0] > 57
            return false
    number := int(value)
    low := if key == "sweeps" or key == "restarts" then 0 elif key == "layer_gap" then 2 else 1
    high := if key == "width" then 40 elif key == "sweeps" then 50 elif key == "seed" then 2147483646 else 9
    if number < low or number > high
        return false
    settings.values[index] = string(number)
    return true

class Node(int id, string label)
class Edge(int first, int second)
class Problem(string kind, int line)
class Graph(string name, Settings settings, Node[] nodes := [], Edge[] edges := [], Edge | none path := none, loops := 0, duplicates := 0, Problem | none problem := none)

int | none node_index(const Node[] nodes, int id)
    for: position < int(#nodes)
        if nodes[position].id == id
            return position
    return none

int | error required_index(const Node[] nodes, int id)
    match node_index(nodes, id)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing node")

bool known(const Node[] nodes, int id)
    match node_index(nodes, id)
        int found
            return true
        none
            return false

Graph[] read_graphs()
    defaults := Settings()
    string params := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    settings_lines := params.split(NL)
    for line := settings_lines[]
        if line != "" and not line.starts_with("#")
            words := line.split(" ")
            accepted := change_setting(&defaults, words[0], words[1])
    string source := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/graphs.txt"))
    lines := source.split(NL)
    Graph[] result := []
    current := Graph("", defaults)
    for: line_index < int(#lines)
        line := lines[line_index]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        if words[0] == "GRAPH"
            current = Graph(words[1], defaults)
            continue
        if words[0] == "END"
            match current.problem
                Problem ignored
                    current.problem = ignored
                none
                    if #current.nodes == 0
                        current.problem = Problem("no_nodes", line_index + 1)
            for: position < int(#current.nodes)
                cursor := position
                while cursor > 0 and current.nodes[cursor].id < current.nodes[cursor - 1].id
                    saved := current.nodes[cursor]
                    current.nodes[cursor] = current.nodes[cursor - 1]
                    current.nodes[cursor - 1] = saved
                    cursor -= 1
            match current.problem
                Problem ignored
                    current.problem = ignored
                none
                    for: position < int(#current.edges)
                        original := current.edges[position]
                        first := required_index(current.nodes, original.first)
                        second := required_index(current.nodes, original.second)
                        current.edges[position] = Edge(first, second)
                    match current.path
                        Edge endpoints
                            first := required_index(current.nodes, endpoints.first)
                            second := required_index(current.nodes, endpoints.second)
                            current.path = Edge(first, second)
                        none
                            current.path = none
            result = result.append(current)
            continue
        skip := false
        match current.problem
            Problem ignored
                skip = true
            none
                skip = false
        if skip
            continue
        string | none reason := none
        if words[0] == "OPTION"
            if not change_setting(&current.settings, words[1], words[2])
                reason = "bad_option"
        elif words[0] == "NODE"
            id := int(words[1])
            if known(current.nodes, id)
                reason = "duplicate_node"
            elif #current.nodes == 40
                reason = "too_many_nodes"
            else
                current.nodes = current.nodes.append(Node(id, words[2]))
        else
            first := int(words[1])
            second := int(words[2])
            edge := Edge(first, second)
            if not known(current.nodes, first) or not known(current.nodes, second)
                reason = "unknown_node"
            elif words[0] == "PATH"
                current.path = edge
            elif first == second
                current.loops += 1
            elif has(current.edges, edge)
                current.duplicates += 1
            else
                current.edges = current.edges.append(edge)
        match reason
            string kind
                current.problem = Problem(kind, line_index + 1)
            none
                current.problem = none
    return result

bool[][] reachability(int count, const io.Edge[] edges)
    bool[][] result := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(count), fill = false))
    for: vertex < count
        result[vertex][vertex] = true
    for edge := edges[]
        result[edge.first][edge.second] = true
    for: middle < count
        for: first < count
            for: second < count
                result[first][second] = result[first][second] or (result[first][middle] and result[middle][second])
    return result

Analysis analyze(const io.Graph graph)
    count := int(#graph.nodes)
    incoming := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    outgoing := incoming
    for edge := graph.edges[]
        outgoing[edge.first] += 1
        incoming[edge.second] += 1
    sources := 0
    sinks := 0
    isolated := 0
    for: vertex < count
        if incoming[vertex] == 0 and outgoing[vertex] > 0
            sources += 1
        if outgoing[vertex] == 0 and incoming[vertex] > 0
            sinks += 1
        if incoming[vertex] == 0 and outgoing[vertex] == 0
            isolated += 1
    visited := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    components := 0
    for: vertex < count
        if visited[vertex]
            continue
        components += 1
        stack := [vertex]
        while #stack != 0
            current := stack[-1]
            stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
            if visited[current]
                continue
            visited[current] = true
            for edge := graph.edges[]
                if edge.first == current
                    stack = stack.append(edge.second)
                if edge.second == current
                    stack = stack.append(edge.first)
    connected := reachability(count, graph.edges)
    assigned := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    int[][] scc := []
    for: vertex < count
        if assigned[vertex]
            continue
        int[] group := []
        for: other < count
            if not assigned[other] and connected[vertex][other] and connected[other][vertex]
                assigned[other] = true
                group = group.append(other)
        if #group > 1
            scc = scc.append(group)
    return Analysis(sources, sinks, isolated, components, scc)

void visit(int vertex, const int[] layer, const int[][] lower, bool[] &visited, int[][] &order)
    if visited[vertex]
        return
    visited[vertex] = true
    order[layer[vertex]] = order[layer[vertex]].append(vertex)
    for successor := lower[vertex][]
        visit(successor, layer, lower, &visited, &order)

Model build_model(const io.Graph graph, const int[] heights, const io.Edge[] dag, const bool[] removed)
    nodes := int(#graph.nodes)
    highest := heights[0]
    for value := heights[]
        highest = io.maximum(highest, value)
    int[] raw := []
    for value := heights[]
        raw = raw.append(highest - value)
    used := io.unique(raw)
    for: edge_index < int(#dag)
        if not removed[edge_index]
            edge := dag[edge_index]
            for: raw[edge.first] + 1 <= level < raw[edge.second]
                used = io.unique(used.append(level))
    used = used.sorted()
    int[] layer := []
    for value := raw[]
        for: position < int(#used)
            if used[position] == value
                layer = layer.append(position)
                break
    int[] width := []
    for node := graph.nodes[]
        width = width.append(int(#node.label) + 2)
    int[][] chains := array(#graph.edges, fill = [])
    for: edge_index < int(#dag)
        if removed[edge_index]
            continue
        edge := dag[edge_index]
        chain := [edge.first]
        for: layer[edge.first] + 1 <= level < layer[edge.second]
            chain = chain.append(int(#layer))
            layer = layer.append(level)
            width = width.append(1)
        chains[edge_index] = chain.append(edge.second)
    crossing.Segment[][] gaps := array(nat(int(#used) - 1), fill = [])
    int[][] upper := array(#layer, fill = [])
    lower := upper
    for: edge_index < int(#chains)
        chain := chains[edge_index]
        for: 1 <= position < int(#chain)
            first := chain[position - 1]
            second := chain[position]
            gaps[layer[first]] = gaps[layer[first]].append(crossing.Segment(first, second, edge_index))
            upper[second] = upper[second].append(first)
            lower[first] = lower[first].append(second)
    int[][] initial := array(#used, fill = [])
    visited := array(#layer, fill = false)
    for: vertex < nodes
        visit(vertex, layer, lower, &visited, &initial)
    return Model(layer, width, chains, gaps, upper, lower, initial)

Key reorder_key(int vertex, const int[][] reference, const int[] places, bool median)
    int[] values := []
    for neighbor := reference[vertex][]
        values = values.append(places[neighbor])
    values = values.sorted()
    if median
        return Key(vertex, values[(int(#values) - 1) / 2] + values[int(#values) / 2], 1)
    total := 0
    for value := values[]
        total += value
    return Key(vertex, total, int(#values))

int[] insert_vertex(const int[] source, int position, int vertex)
    int[] result := []
    for: cursor < int(#source) + 1
        if cursor == position
            result = result.append(vertex)
        if cursor < int(#source)
            result = result.append(source[cursor])
    return result

Reduction reduce_crossings(const io.Graph graph, const Model model)
    vertices := int(#model.layer)
    int random_state := graph.settings.integer("seed")
    string[] records := []
    string[] csv := []
    adopted := model.initial
    best_count := 2147483647
    best_run := 0
    best_sweep := 0
    initial := 0
    for: int run < graph.settings.integer("restarts") + 1
        order := model.initial
        if run > 0
            for: row < int(#order)
                cursor := int(#order[row]) - 1
                while cursor > 0
                    random_state = 48271 * random_state % 2147483647
                    selected := random_state % (cursor + 1)
                    saved := order[row][cursor]
                    order[row][cursor] = order[row][selected]
                    order[row][selected] = saved
                    cursor -= 1
        current_count := crossing.total(model.gaps, order, vertices)
        if run == 0
            initial = current_count
        run_count := current_count
        run_sweep := 0
        run_order := order
        history := [order]
        counts := [current_count]
        records = records.append("sweep {run} 0 initial crossings {current_count}")
        csv = csv.append("{graph.name},{run},0,{current_count}")
        for: 1 <= int sweep < graph.settings.integer("sweeps") + 1
            last := sweep - 1
            if counts[last] == 0 or (last >= 2 and history[last] == history[last - 2])
                break
            old := crossing.positions(order, vertices)
            down := sweep % 2 == 1
            int[] row_order := []
            if down
                for: 1 <= row < int(#order)
                    row_order = row_order.append(row)
            else
                row := int(#order) - 2
                while row >= 0
                    row_order = row_order.append(row)
                    row -= 1
            reference := if down then model.upper else model.lower
            for row := row_order[]
                places := crossing.positions(order, vertices)
                Key[] moving := []
                for vertex := order[row][]
                    if #reference[vertex] > 0
                        moving = moving.append(reorder_key(vertex, reference, places, graph.settings.text("heuristic") == "median"))
                for: position < int(#moving)
                    cursor := position
                    while cursor > 0
                        left := moving[cursor]
                        right := moving[cursor - 1]
                        if left.numerator * right.denominator >= right.numerator * left.denominator
                            break
                        moving[cursor] = right
                        moving[cursor - 1] = left
                        cursor -= 1
                next := 0
                for: position < int(#order[row])
                    if #reference[order[row][position]] > 0
                        order[row][position] = moving[next].vertex
                        next += 1
            places := crossing.positions(order, vertices)
            moved := 0
            for: vertex < vertices
                if places[vertex] != old[vertex]
                    moved += 1
            swaps := 0
            while true
                changed := false
                for: row < int(#order)
                    for: position < int(#order[row]) - 1
                        first := order[row][position]
                        second := order[row][position + 1]
                        if crossing.adjacent(first, second, model.upper, model.lower, places) > crossing.adjacent(second, first, model.upper, model.lower, places)
                            order[row][position] = second
                            order[row][position + 1] = first
                            places[first] = position + 1
                            places[second] = position
                            swaps += 1
                            changed = true
                if not changed
                    break
            current_count = crossing.total(model.gaps, order, vertices)
            history = history.append(order)
            counts = counts.append(current_count)
            direction := if down then "down" else "up"
            records = records.append("sweep {run} {sweep} {direction} moved {moved} swaps {swaps} crossings {current_count}")
            csv = csv.append("{graph.name},{run},{sweep},{current_count}")
            if current_count < run_count
                run_count = current_count
                run_sweep = sweep
                run_order = order
        if run_count < best_count
            best_count = run_count
            best_run = run
            best_sweep = run_sweep
            adopted = run_order
    records = records.append("best run {best_run} sweep {best_sweep} crossings {best_count}")
    if graph.settings.on("sifting")
        round := 0
        while true
            round += 1
            moves := 0
            for: vertex < vertices
                row := model.layer[vertex]
                old := 0
                int[] base := []
                for: position < int(#adopted[row])
                    if adopted[row][position] == vertex
                        old = position
                    else
                        base = base.append(adopted[row][position])
                int[] costs := []
                minimum_cost := 2147483647
                for: position < int(#base) + 1
                    adopted[row] = insert_vertex(base, position, vertex)
                    value := crossing.total(model.gaps, adopted, vertices)
                    costs = costs.append(value)
                    minimum_cost = io.minimum(minimum_cost, value)
                chosen := old
                if costs[old] != minimum_cost
                    for: position < int(#costs)
                        if costs[position] == minimum_cost
                            chosen = position
                            break
                adopted[row] = insert_vertex(base, chosen, vertex)
                if chosen != old
                    moves += 1
            records = records.append("sift {round} moves {moves} crossings {crossing.total(model.gaps, adopted, vertices)}")
            if moves == 0
                break
    return Reduction(adopted, records, csv, initial, best_count, best_run, best_sweep)

Geometry geometry(const io.Graph graph, const Model model, const int[][] order, const coordinates.Coordinates placement)
    int[] tracks := []
    int[] gaps := []
    int[][] offsets := []
    for segments := model.gaps[]
        bent_counts := array(#model.layer, fill = 0)
        for segment := segments[]
            if placement.x[segment.upper] != placement.x[segment.lower]
                bent_counts[segment.upper] += 1
        Bus[] buses := []
        for: segment_index < int(#segments)
            segment := segments[segment_index]
            first_x := placement.x[segment.upper]
            second_x := placement.x[segment.lower]
            if first_x == second_x
                continue
            side := if bent_counts[segment.upper] >= 2 then 0 else 1
            vertex := if side == 0 then segment.upper else segment.lower
            low := io.minimum(first_x, second_x)
            high := io.maximum(first_x, second_x)
            bus_index := -1
            for: position < int(#buses)
                if buses[position].side == side and buses[position].vertex == vertex
                    bus_index = position
                    break
            if bus_index < 0
                buses = buses.append(Bus(low, high, side, vertex, placement.x[vertex], [segment_index]))
            else
                buses[bus_index].low = io.minimum(buses[bus_index].low, low)
                buses[bus_index].high = io.maximum(buses[bus_index].high, high)
                buses[bus_index].members = buses[bus_index].members.append(segment_index)
        for: position < int(#buses)
            cursor := position
            while cursor > 0
                first := buses[cursor]
                second := buses[cursor - 1]
                if io.compare([first.low, first.high, first.side, first.x], [second.low, second.high, second.side, second.x]) >= 0
                    break
                buses[cursor] = second
                buses[cursor - 1] = first
                cursor -= 1
        int[] ends := []
        assignments := array(#segments, fill = -1)
        for bus := buses[]
            track := -1
            for: position < int(#ends)
                if ends[position] + 1 < bus.low
                    track = position
                    break
            if track < 0
                track = int(#ends)
                ends = ends.append(bus.high)
            else
                ends[track] = bus.high
            for member := bus.members[]
                assignments[member] = track + 1
        gap := io.maximum(graph.settings.integer("layer_gap"), int(#ends) + 2)
        for: position < int(#assignments)
            if assignments[position] >= 0
                assignments[position] += (gap - 2 - int(#ends)) / 2
        tracks = tracks.append(int(#ends))
        gaps = gaps.append(gap)
        offsets = offsets.append(assignments)
    string direction := graph.settings.text("direction")
    vertical := direction == "TB" or direction == "BT"
    int[] thickness := []
    for row := order[]
        value := 1
        if not vertical
            for vertex := row[]
                value = io.maximum(value, model.width[vertex])
        thickness = thickness.append(value)
    starts := array(#order, fill = 0)
    for: 1 <= row < int(#order)
        starts[row] = starts[row - 1] + thickness[row - 1] + gaps[row - 1]
    main_length := starts[-1] + thickness[-1]
    secondary_length := 0
    for: vertex < int(#model.layer)
        secondary_length = io.maximum(secondary_length, placement.x[vertex] + placement.right[vertex] + 1)
    return Geometry(tracks, gaps, offsets, thickness, starts, main_length, secondary_length)

int[] | none shortest_path(const io.Graph graph, const bool[] removed)
    match graph.path
        io.Edge endpoints
            parent := array(#graph.nodes, fill = -1)
            visited := array(#graph.nodes, fill = false)
            visited[endpoints.first] = true
            queue := [endpoints.first]
            position := 0
            while position < int(#queue)
                vertex := queue[position]
                position += 1
                int[] neighbors := []
                for: edge_index < int(#graph.edges)
                    if not removed[edge_index] and graph.edges[edge_index].first == vertex
                        neighbors = neighbors.append(graph.edges[edge_index].second)
                neighbors = neighbors.sorted()
                for neighbor := neighbors[]
                    if not visited[neighbor]
                        visited[neighbor] = true
                        parent[neighbor] = vertex
                        queue = queue.append(neighbor)
            if not visited[endpoints.second]
                return none
            current := endpoints.second
            path := [current]
            while current != endpoints.first
                current = parent[current]
                path = path.append(current)
            return path[::-1]
        none
            return none

Drawing draw(const io.Graph graph, const Model model, const coordinates.Coordinates placement, const Geometry shape, const bool[] reversed, const bool[] removed, const int[] | none path)
    string direction := graph.settings.text("direction")
    vertical := direction == "TB" or direction == "BT"
    picture := canvas.Canvas(shape.main_length, shape.secondary_length, direction)
    for: vertex < int(#model.layer)
        row := model.layer[vertex]
        if vertex >= int(#graph.nodes)
            for: position < shape.thickness[row]
                canvas.line(&picture, shape.starts[row] + position, placement.x[vertex], true)
        elif not vertical and #model.lower[vertex] > 0
            for: model.width[vertex] <= position < shape.thickness[row]
                canvas.line(&picture, shape.starts[row] + position, placement.x[vertex], true)
    for: gap_index < int(#model.gaps)
        start := shape.starts[gap_index] + shape.thickness[gap_index]
        gap := shape.gaps[gap_index]
        segments := model.gaps[gap_index]
        for: segment_index < int(#segments)
            segment := segments[segment_index]
            first_x := placement.x[segment.upper]
            second_x := placement.x[segment.lower]
            offset := shape.offsets[gap_index][segment_index]
            if offset >= 0
                for: position < offset
                    canvas.line(&picture, start + position, first_x, true)
                canvas.corner(&picture, start + offset, first_x)
                canvas.corner(&picture, start + offset, second_x)
                for: io.minimum(first_x, second_x) + 1 <= secondary < io.maximum(first_x, second_x)
                    canvas.line(&picture, start + offset, secondary, false)
                for: offset + 1 <= position < gap
                    canvas.line(&picture, start + position, second_x, true)
            else
                for: position < gap
                    canvas.line(&picture, start + position, first_x, true)
    canvas.Cell[][] routes := array(#graph.edges, fill = [])
    lengths := array(#graph.edges, fill = 0)
    bends := lengths
    for: edge_index < int(#model.chains)
        if removed[edge_index]
            continue
        chain := model.chains[edge_index]
        first := chain[0]
        second := chain[-1]
        upper_main := shape.starts[model.layer[first]] + (if vertical then 1 else model.width[first])
        lower_main := shape.starts[model.layer[second]] - 1
        points := [canvas.map_cell(picture, upper_main, placement.x[first])]
        for: 1 <= position < int(#chain)
            upper_vertex := chain[position - 1]
            lower_vertex := chain[position]
            gap_index := model.layer[upper_vertex]
            offset := -1
            for: segment_index < int(#model.gaps[gap_index])
                segment := model.gaps[gap_index][segment_index]
                if segment.upper == upper_vertex and segment.lower == lower_vertex
                    offset = shape.offsets[gap_index][segment_index]
                    break
            if offset >= 0
                main_coordinate := shape.starts[gap_index] + shape.thickness[gap_index] + offset
                points = points.append(canvas.map_cell(picture, main_coordinate, placement.x[upper_vertex]))
                points = points.append(canvas.map_cell(picture, main_coordinate, placement.x[lower_vertex]))
                bends[edge_index] += 2
        points = points.append(canvas.map_cell(picture, lower_main, placement.x[second]))
        if reversed[edge_index]
            points = points[::-1]
            canvas.arrow(&picture, upper_main, placement.x[first], true)
        else
            canvas.arrow(&picture, lower_main, placement.x[second], false)
        length := 1
        for: 1 <= position < int(#points)
            length += io.absolute(points[position].row - points[position - 1].row) + io.absolute(points[position].column - points[position - 1].column)
        lengths[edge_index] = length
        routes[edge_index] = points
    int[] on_path := []
    match path
        int[] found
            on_path = found
            for: 1 <= position < int(#found)
                edge_index := 0
                while graph.edges[edge_index] != io.Edge(found[position - 1], found[position])
                    edge_index += 1
                points := routes[edge_index]
                for: 1 <= point_index < int(#points)
                    first := points[point_index - 1]
                    second := points[point_index]
                    if first.row == second.row
                        for: io.minimum(first.column, second.column) <= column < io.maximum(first.column, second.column) + 1
                            canvas.highlight(&picture, first.row, column)
                    else
                        for: io.minimum(first.row, second.row) <= row < io.maximum(first.row, second.row) + 1
                            canvas.highlight(&picture, row, first.column)
        none
            on_path = []
    for: vertex < int(#graph.nodes)
        row := model.layer[vertex]
        highlighted := io.has(on_path, vertex)
        string text := (if highlighted then "{{" else "[") + graph.nodes[vertex].label + (if highlighted then "}}" else "]")
        cell := if vertical then canvas.map_cell(picture, shape.starts[row], placement.x[vertex] - placement.left[vertex]) elif direction == "LR" then canvas.Cell(placement.x[vertex], shape.starts[row]) else canvas.Cell(placement.x[vertex], shape.main_length - shape.starts[row] - model.width[vertex])
        canvas.label(&picture, cell.row, cell.column, text)
    return Drawing(picture, routes, lengths, bends)

string node_name(const io.Graph graph, int vertex)
    return if vertex < int(#graph.nodes) then string(graph.nodes[vertex].id) else "d{vertex - int(#graph.nodes) + 1}"

string edge_name(const io.Graph graph, int edge_index)
    io.Edge edge := graph.edges[edge_index]
    return "{node_name(graph, edge.first)}->{node_name(graph, edge.second)}"

string[] node_names(const io.Graph graph, const int[] vertices)
    string[] result := []
    for vertex := vertices[]
        result = result.append(node_name(graph, vertex))
    return result

Processed process_graph(const io.Graph graph)
    nodes := int(#graph.nodes)
    analysis := analyze(graph)
    sequence := layering.sequence(nodes, graph.edges)
    places := array(nat(nodes), fill = 0)
    for: position < int(#sequence)
        places[sequence[position]] = position
    bool[] reversed := []
    io.Edge[] dag := []
    for edge := graph.edges[]
        reverse := places[edge.first] > places[edge.second]
        reversed = reversed.append(reverse)
        dag = dag.append(if reverse then io.Edge(edge.second, edge.first) else edge)
    reachable := reachability(nodes, dag)
    removed := array(#dag, fill = false)
    io.Edge[] drawn := []
    for: edge_index < int(#dag)
        edge := dag[edge_index]
        if graph.settings.on("reduce") and not reversed[edge_index]
            for other := dag[]
                if other.first == edge.first and other.second != edge.second and reachable[other.second][edge.second]
                    removed[edge_index] = true
        if not removed[edge_index]
            drawn = drawn.append(edge)
    levels := layering.assign(nodes, drawn, graph.settings.text("layering") == "coffman", graph.settings.integer("width"), graph.settings.on("promotion"))
    model := build_model(graph, levels.heights, dag, removed)
    reduced := reduce_crossings(graph, model)
    string direction := graph.settings.text("direction")
    placement := coordinates.assign(nodes, reduced.order, model.layer, model.upper, model.lower, model.width, direction == "TB" or direction == "BT", graph.settings.integer("node_sep"), graph.settings.integer("dummy_sep"))
    shape := geometry(graph, model, reduced.order, placement)
    int[] | none path := shortest_path(graph, removed)
    drawing := draw(graph, model, placement, shape, reversed, removed, path)
    vertices := int(#model.layer)
    positions := crossing.positions(reduced.order, vertices)
    int[] counts := []
    final_count := 0
    brute := 0
    edge_crossings := array(#graph.edges, fill = 0)
    for: gap_index < int(#model.gaps)
        segments := model.gaps[gap_index]
        value := crossing.count(segments, positions, int(#reduced.order[gap_index + 1]))
        counts = counts.append(value)
        final_count += value
        brute += crossing.brute(segments, positions)
        for: first < int(#segments)
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#segments)
                if crossing.crosses(segments[first], segments[second], positions)
                    edge_crossings[segments[first].edge] += 1
                    edge_crossings[segments[second].edge] += 1
    string[] settings_words := []
    names := io.setting_names()
    for: position < int(#names)
        settings_words = settings_words.append("{names[position]}={graph.settings.values[position]}")
    sequence_names := node_names(graph, sequence)
    layout := ["graph {graph.name}", "settings {settings_words.join(" ")}", "acyclic {sequence_names.join(" ")}"]
    if graph.settings.text("layering") == "coffman"
        string[] labels := []
        for: vertex < nodes
            labels = labels.append("{node_name(graph, vertex)}:{levels.labels[vertex]}")
        layout = layout.append("labels {labels.join(" ")}")
    for entry := levels.promotions[]
        layout = layout.append("promote {entry.round} {node_name(graph, entry.vertex)} {entry.diff}")
    layout = layout.concat(reduced.records)
    for: row < int(#reduced.order)
        start := shape.starts[row]
        finish := start + shape.thickness[row] - 1
        backwards := direction == "BT" or direction == "RL"
        band_low := if backwards then shape.main_length - 1 - finish else start
        band_high := if backwards then shape.main_length - 1 - start else finish
        ordered := reduced.order[row]
        low := placement.x[ordered[0]] - placement.left[ordered[0]]
        high := placement.x[ordered[0]] + placement.right[ordered[0]]
        string[] labels := []
        for vertex := ordered[]
            low = io.minimum(low, placement.x[vertex] - placement.left[vertex])
            high = io.maximum(high, placement.x[vertex] + placement.right[vertex])
            labels = labels.append("{node_name(graph, vertex)}@{placement.x[vertex]}")
        layout = layout.append("layer {row} band {band_low} {band_high} extent {low} {high} : {labels.join(" ")}")
    for: gap_index < int(#model.gaps)
        layout = layout.append("between {gap_index} {gap_index + 1} segments {#model.gaps[gap_index]} crossings {counts[gap_index]} tracks {shape.tracks[gap_index]} gap {shape.gaps[gap_index]}")
    variants := ["ul", "ur", "dl", "dr"]
    string[] variants_text := []
    for: variant < 4
        variants_text = variants_text.append("{variants[variant]}={placement.blocks[variant]}/{placement.widths[variant]}")
    layout = layout.append("bk conflicts {placement.conflicts} {variants_text.join(" ")} smallest {variants[placement.smallest]}")
    for row := reduced.order[]
        for vertex := row[]
            layout = layout.append("vertex {node_name(graph, vertex)} layer {model.layer[vertex]} pos {positions[vertex]} ul {placement.aligned[0][vertex]} ur {placement.aligned[1][vertex]} dl {placement.aligned[2][vertex]} dr {placement.aligned[3][vertex]} x {placement.x[vertex]}")
    for: edge_index < int(#graph.edges)
        io.Edge edge := graph.edges[edge_index]
        prefix := "edge {node_name(graph, edge.first)} {node_name(graph, edge.second)}"
        if removed[edge_index]
            layout = layout.append("{prefix} transitive")
        else
            chain := if reversed[edge_index] then model.chains[edge_index][::-1] else model.chains[edge_index]
            string[] path_words := []
            for vertex := chain[]
                path_words = path_words.append(string(placement.x[vertex]))
            string[] route_words := []
            for cell := drawing.routes[edge_index][]
                route_words = route_words.append("{cell.row},{cell.column}")
            reversal := if reversed[edge_index] then " reversed" else ""
            layout = layout.append("{prefix}{reversal} span {int(#chain) - 1} crossings {edge_crossings[edge_index]} bends {drawing.bends[edge_index]} path {path_words.join(" ")} route {route_words.join(" ")}")
    layout = layout.append("end")
    stats := ["graph {graph.name}", "nodes {nodes} edges {#graph.edges} self_loops {graph.loops} duplicates {graph.duplicates}", "sources {analysis.sources} sinks {analysis.sinks} isolated {analysis.isolated} components {analysis.components}"]
    for component := analysis.scc[]
        labels := node_names(graph, component)
        stats = stats.append("scc {labels.join(" ")}")
    for: kind < 2
        flags := if kind == 0 then reversed else removed
        label := if kind == 0 then "reversed" else "transitive"
        string[] labels := []
        for: edge_index < int(#graph.edges)
            if flags[edge_index]
                labels = labels.append(edge_name(graph, edge_index))
        suffix := if #labels == 0 then "" else " {labels.join(" ")}"
        stats = stats.append("{label} {#labels}{suffix}")
    max_nodes := 0
    max_vertices := 0
    for row := reduced.order[]
        node_count := 0
        for vertex := row[]
            if vertex < nodes
                node_count += 1
        max_nodes = io.maximum(max_nodes, node_count)
        max_vertices = io.maximum(max_vertices, int(#row))
    stats = stats.append("layers {#reduced.order} max_nodes {max_nodes} max_vertices {max_vertices}")
    if graph.settings.on("promotion")
        stats = stats.append("promotion rounds {levels.rounds} accepted {#levels.promotions} dummies_before {levels.before}")
    else
        stats = stats.append("promotion off")
    spans := array(#reduced.order, fill = 0)
    span_total := 0
    span_max := 0
    long_edges := 0
    vertical_edges := 0
    for chain := model.chains[]
        if #chain == 0
            continue
        span := int(#chain) - 1
        spans[span] += 1
        span_total += span
        span_max = io.maximum(span_max, span)
        if span >= 2
            long_edges += 1
            equal := true
            for: 1 <= position < int(#chain) - 1
                if placement.x[chain[position]] != placement.x[chain[1]]
                    equal = false
            if equal
                vertical_edges += 1
    stats = stats.append("dummies {vertices - nodes} span_total {span_total} span_max {span_max}")
    string[] span_words := []
    for: span < int(#spans)
        if spans[span] > 0
            span_words = span_words.append("{span}:{spans[span]}")
    stats = stats.append("spans " + (if #span_words == 0 then "none" else span_words.join(" ")))
    stats = stats.append("long_edges {long_edges} vertical {vertical_edges}")
    stats = stats.append("crossings initial {reduced.initial} swept {reduced.swept} best_run {reduced.run} best_sweep {reduced.sweep} final {final_count} brute {brute}")
    segment_count := 0
    straight := 0
    offset := 0
    for gap := model.gaps[]
        for segment := gap[]
            segment_count += 1
            distance := io.absolute(placement.x[segment.upper] - placement.x[segment.lower])
            offset += distance
            if distance == 0
                straight += 1
    stats = stats.append("segments {segment_count} straight {straight} bent {segment_count - straight} offset {offset}")
    route_length := 0
    bends := 0
    longest := -1
    for: edge_index < int(#graph.edges)
        route_length += drawing.lengths[edge_index]
        bends += drawing.bends[edge_index]
        if not removed[edge_index] and (longest < 0 or drawing.lengths[edge_index] > drawing.lengths[longest])
            longest = edge_index
    longest_text := if longest < 0 then "" else " longest {edge_name(graph, longest)} {drawing.lengths[longest]}"
    stats = stats.append("routes length {route_length} bends {bends}{longest_text}")
    stats = stats.append("canvas width {drawing.picture.columns} height {drawing.picture.rows} crossing_cells {canvas.crossings(drawing.picture)}")
    match graph.path
        io.Edge endpoints
            match path
                int[] found
                    labels := node_names(graph, found)
                    stats = stats.append("path {node_name(graph, endpoints.first)} {node_name(graph, endpoints.second)} hops {int(#found) - 1} : {labels.join(" ")}")
                none
                    stats = stats.append("path {node_name(graph, endpoints.first)} {node_name(graph, endpoints.second)} none")
        none
            stats = stats
    stats = stats.append("end")
    drawings := ["graph {graph.name} {drawing.picture.columns}x{drawing.picture.rows}"]
    drawings = drawings.concat(canvas.report(drawing.picture))
    return Processed(layout, stats, reduced.csv, drawings, [nodes, int(#graph.edges), vertices - nodes, reduced.initial, final_count])

void write_output(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    io.Graph[] graphs := io.read_graphs()
    string[] layout := []
    string[] stats := []
    string[] drawings := []
    csv := ["graph,run,sweep,crossings"]
    totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    errors := 0
    for graph := graphs[]
        if #drawings > 0
            drawings = drawings.append("")
        match graph.problem
            io.Problem problem
                errors += 1
                block := ["graph {graph.name}", "error {problem.kind} line {problem.line}", "end"]
                layout = layout.concat(block)
                stats = stats.concat(block)
                drawings = drawings.append("graph {graph.name} error {problem.kind}")
            none
                output := process_graph(graph)
                layout = layout.concat(output.layout)
                stats = stats.concat(output.stats)
                csv = csv.concat(output.csv)
                drawings = drawings.concat(output.drawings)
                for: position < 5
                    totals[position] += output.totals[position]
    stats = stats.append("summary graphs {#graphs} laid_out {int(#graphs) - errors} errors {errors} nodes {totals[0]} edges {totals[1]} dummies {totals[2]} crossings_initial {totals[3]} crossings_final {totals[4]}")
    write_output("layout.txt", layout)
    write_output("stats.txt", stats)
    write_output("crossings.csv", csv)
    write_output("drawings.txt", drawings)

if main
    run_program()
